descriptor: Team planning tool with three simple plans

voice.summary: Sounds like a helpful sales colleague who actually wants you to choose the cheap plan if it fits: easy, reassuring and light on pressure. Prices are round, limits are visible and cancelling is easy.
dos: Pair each plan with who it suits
Say cancel any time near the price
Keep the Most popular label modest
donts: Do not use dark patterns or fake urgency
Do not hide limits in small print
Do not push the biggest plan

taglines: Simple plans that grow with you
Start free, upgrade when it makes sense
Pay for what your team uses
boilerplate: Tallyfold is a team planning tool sold on three simple plans, Starter, Studio and Scale, starting free, billed monthly or yearly and cancellable at any time.

microcopy.success: Plan chosen. Your trial has started.
microcopy.error: We couldn't start that plan. Please try again.

logo.note: Three stacked layers depict the three plans in rising order.
